item.title: Police investigate a potential explosion outside the US Embassy in Oslo
item.description: "This is an unacceptable incident that is being treated with the utmost seriousness," said Astri Aas-Hansen, Norway's minister of justice and public security.

item.title: Armed robbery suspect killed in police shooting at 7-Eleven in Harbor Gateway, LAPD says
item.description: A robbery at a 7-Eleven in Harbor Gateway turned deadly after LAPD says officers were confronted by an armed suspect.

item.title: Trump's 'roaring' economy meets a rough start to 2026: What the latest numbers show
item.description: President Donald Trump promised that 2026 would be a bumper year for economic growth, but instead it has kicked off with job losses, rising gasoline prices and more uncertainty about America's future.

item.title: Sugar the Surfing Dog rides last wave as beloved SoCal pup battles cancer
item.description: Sugar the Surfing Dog rode her last wave over the weekend as the beloved SoCal pup continues battling cancer.

item.title: Decades after violence in Selma spurred the Voting Rights Act, organizers worry about its fate
item.description: The March 7, 1965, violence that became known as Bloody Sunday shocked the nation and helped spur passage of the landmark legislation that dismantled barriers to voting for Black Americans in the Jim Crow South.

item.title: 'Ghostbusters' actress Jennifer Runyon dies at 65
item.description: Jennifer Runyon, the actress known for her roles in "Ghostbusters" and "Charles in Charge," has died.

item.title: American Nathan Martin wins LA Marathon in race's closest finish ever
item.description: American Nathan Martin won the men's race in what L.A. Marathon officials called the closest finish the event has ever seen.

item.title: Crude oil prices surpass $100 a barrel as the Iran war impedes production and shipping
item.description: Supply concerns have driven crude and gasoline higher as the war ensnares major oil-producing countries and hinders exports from the Persian Gulf.

item.title: SoCal to see brief cooldown to start the week before heat returns
item.description: Southern California will see a brief cooldown at the start of the week before another round of summer-like heat moves into the region.

item.title: Rihanna's LA area mansion struck by gunfire, woman arrested, police say
item.description: Rihanna's Beverly Glen mansion was hit by gunfire while the singer was home, according to police and sources with knowledge of the investigation.
